title: What Is a Park For? Data, lexicon, codebook and code
description: Replication materials for 'What Is a Park For? Measuring the Health Framing of Urban Green Space Across 22 European Capitals': a 92-term two-layer lexicon in 22 languages (green space referents and health pathway terms), the codebook for the human reading, a taxonomy of seven retrieval collision classes, the coded census of 1,520 mayoral posts (identifiers and codes only, no post texts), the intra-coder re-code sample, and code reproducing the paper's tables.
